description: He wears a deep brown plum long outer coat with narrow gold patterned borders along the open front, collar, cuffs and hem. A cream undertunic shows in the central opening, gathered at the waist by a decorated brown belt with a round gold buckle and hanging strap. Dark trousers end inside tall brown leather boots. The head is bare and the hands are held behind his body, naturally hidden. The long sleeves and layered coat cover the arms and torso; the complete standing figure and both boots are visible.
